text:
maria: Quick heads-up — kicking off the monthly least-privilege sweep for infra & admin entitlements. I want to validate KMS grants, recent service-account role changes, and owner assignments before we prune. Who's got the latest KMS loghook query?
aj: I can grab the logs. Two quick notes: payments-svcacct is still on the migration exemption until 2025-05-01, and we should avoid touching any svcacct with active support tickets.
samir: Here's a starter KMS query I used in staging:```sql
SELECT grantee, key_id, grant_id, created_at, principal_email
FROM kms_grants
WHERE created_at > '2024-12-01'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 1000;
```That shows grant age + principal. We should cross-ref with ownership table.
maria: perfect — can you run that and drop results here? Also we need the recent RBAC diffs for infra-admin and cluster-admin roles (last 90d).
audit-bot: Scheduled: `access-sweep infra` started by maria at 2025-03-12T14:12Z. Attachment: run-id=rswp-3611. Will post aggregated evidence when finished. :robot_face:
leo: FYI I ran a quick cross-check yesterday — ~18 grants look stale (>730d) but 7 are used by automation (tagged `automation:yes`). We should only prune non-automations first.
aj: Results pasted: (truncated)
```
grantee: serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com, key_id: proj-key-1, grant_id: g-421, created_at: 2022-01-05, principal_email: ci-runner@...
grantee: user:ops-oncall@redwood.com, key_id: proj-key-2, grant_id: g-899, created_at: 2024-06-11, principal_email: ops-oncall@...
...
```
maria: thanks. Action plan proposal: 1) build evidence bundle for grants > 365d and not tagged automation, 2) reach out to owners with suggested removal + 7d SLA, 3) auto-queue removal for no-response after 14d in a controlled canary. Thoughts?
samir: +1. Add a final safety step: run a smoke test job that exercises the common automation paths that reference the keys before removal. We can run it in prod-readonly and flag failures.
ops-oncall: Please add me to the owner pings (ops-oncall). If we get a surprise auth failure during the canary I need to know within 15m. Also mark the canary window 03:00-05:00 UTC to minimize user impact.
maria: agreed on timings. I'll prepare the owner ping template. Draft: 
```
Hi <owner>,
We're doing a routine entitlement cleanup. Key <key_id> shows last grant at <created_at> and no automation tag. If you still need it, reply with justification or update the `automation` tag in infra catalogs within 7 days. Otherwise we'll remove the grant on <date+14>.
Questions? Reply here or DM security.
```
leo: Small ask — when removing grants, also rotate any related API tokens or deploy keys that might assume the grant exists. We should include rotation checklist in the removal ticket.
maria: good call. I'll add a rotation checkbox and a rollback playbook link.
audit-bot: Evidence bundle rswp-3611 uploaded: s3://redwood-audit/access-sweep/rswp-3611/ (contains kms_grants.csv, rbac_diffs.json, owner_candidates.csv)
aj: Quick vuln triage side-note: two infra-admin members had MFA failures last week — not related to grants but worth flagging in the owner outreach so they verify MFA.
maria: include that note. Also ping legal if any removal affects archived compliance keys.
samir: One more technical note — some grants are attached to cross-project keys. Make sure `key_id` namespace is included in the removal run to avoid cross-project accidental deletes.
maria: noted. I'll include a scoped removal script that validates `project_id` against the owner catalog before executing. Example:```bash
python scripts/remove_grant.py --grant g-421 --project proj-123 --check-owner-catalog
```
ops-oncall: If you want, ops can stand by during the initial canary removals. I can add an alert for any 401s originating from jobs that previously used the key.
maria: yes please. ops-oncall, can you create a temporary Prometheus alert: `rbac.removal.auth_failures > 5 in 15m` and mute other noisy rules for the window?
ops-oncall: On it. I'll post the alert ID once created.
aj: last logistics: I'll batch owner pings into 50 per day to avoid spam and add a Notion checklist. Link to checklist once live.
maria: thanks all — next steps: aj to drop full query output and owner candidates by EOD, audit-bot already uploaded initial bundle, samir to validate smoke tests, ops-oncall to prepare alerts. I'll open a tracking ticket and post the Notion link. Closing note: try to keep replies in-thread so we have auditable discussion. :lock:
leo: ACK.
